name: Garnier Hair Conditioner Pineapple
description: Garnier Fructis Hair Food Pineapple Conditioner 350ml is a deeply nourishing conditioner designed to meet the needs of dull hair. By incorporating the natural benefits of pineapple, this conditioner focuses on adding shine to the hair and locking in moisture, leaving strands shiny, hydrated, and soft. Pineapple extract is rich in vitamins and not only helps boost hair shine but also protects the hair against aggression. The formula ensures that hair remains smooth and manageable without becoming heavy or weighed down. Ideal for long, dull hair, it also helps with detangling, making it easier to comb through and maintain. Lasting nourishment is a key feature, as the inclusion of a nourishing complex, omegas, and fatty acids, provides deep conditioning that results in nourished, soft hair. All in all, these ingredients work together to deeply nurture the hair and counteract dryness. This conditioner also helps in reducing split ends.
